kaikki_wiktionary_hebrew.label: Kaikki machine-readable Hebrew dictionary from English Wiktionary
kaikki_wiktionary_hebrew.declared_from: The entry's own structure, read across all 123,558 routes. The route is the whole definition in 123,466 rows and the definition's tail after a leading label group in 92 (M50, M69: the store cut '(anatomy)', '(clothing)' and the like off the front). The provider writes Wiktionary's gloss line: English equivalents divided by commas (69,591 dividing commas in 50,469 routes), senses by semicolons (4,280), a head and its explanation by a colon (5,768), and every parenthesis a note, never an alternative (28,641 groups, 0 divide). Under this declaration 56,309 routes divide into 136,685 pieces, and 0 fail to rejoin character for character.

regions.locate: The route is read as it stands; the definition is never mined. Within the route: ';' and a sentence '.' cut segments; a segment that opens as a note (used, see, said of, indicating, also, it, this, ...) is a note; ':' cuts a segment into parts: the head before it, then an explanation, a gloss list after a form pointer, a pointer after a gloss, or a copied Strong's KJV list after ': -'. A part carrying Hebrew letters outside parentheses is a form pointer.
regions.role_meaning: head, explanation, gloss: readings. pointer: a form-of pointer ('plural of X (x)'), kept as a piece, no reading. note: a usage note or cross-reference, kept as a piece, no reading. strongs_list: a copied Strong's KJV list, kept whole.

precedence: ( ) [ ] and quotation marks scope every divider
a lead or closing context label holds the line
an unclosed '(' holds everything from it
kaikki_wiktionary_hebrew.precedence_note: Each divider divides only at depth 0, outside quotations, and in order: ';' and the sentence '.' cut the line into senses, ':' cuts a sense into head and explanation (or pointer and glosses), ',' cuts a part into renderings. A part that carries any holding comma (clause opener, serial conjunction, relative, label, etc., shared object, bare qualifier group) is held whole, commas and all. '/', '-', quotes, apostrophes, Hebrew points, maqaf, geresh and the symbols never divide.

line_label.why: A label at the head of the line ('(intransitive) to soak, permeate') or after its last period ('To leaven, ferment. (of dough)') governs every gloss in it; dividing would leave the label on one piece and strip it from the rest (the August Bolls binyan-header precedent).

unbalanced.rule: separate up to the first unclosed '(' or '['; ship the rest whole (the August opener_never_closed rule)
unbalanced.note: Today's card prints nothing for these 32 routes (a damaged sense is dropped); this declaration ships each whole.

marks.divides: sense from sense, glosses from a note
sentence from sentence, the gloss from a closing note
head from explanation, pointer from glosses, gloss from pointer, definition from a Strong's list

separates_on.rule: Separate at the declared shapes only. Every piece is kept; no piece is joined to another; no label is carried onto a piece it was not written on; no group is distributed over its head; no sigil, label or romanization is stripped.

compared_with_v3.path: the card's path: zone.html's depth-0 ';' split, then sense-split-v1.mjs's senseSplit on each sense (the card's readingSplit equals it on all 127,842 senses)

open_for_the_owner: 1. The colon. 5,768 depth-0 colons stand between a head gloss and the explanation that defines it ('A tunnel: an underground or underwater passage'). Reading A (declared): the colon divides, the head and the explanation are each a reading. Reading B: the explanation defines the head and is no reading of its own; the head alone is the reading and the explanation prints as the record's note. v3 never divides at ':' and so prints the whole sentence, or cuts at the commas around it. Colon divisions are a cause in 3,135 + 3,170 disagreeing routes.

2. A long piece in a gloss list. 5,326 pieces of more than 4 words stand beside a dividing comma in 4,981 routes ('cobra, snake of the family Elapidae'; 'to pass, to not fail a test'). Reading A (declared): Wiktionary's comma lists equivalents, a describing equivalent among them, and the comma divides wherever no clause, conjunction, relative, label or etc. follows it. Reading B (v3): a piece over 4 words makes the field a sentence; the short pieces are readings and the whole field stands beside them.

3. Pieces that are no readings. Division keeps 625 note pieces and 552 form-pointer pieces ('used in forming questions.'; 'defective spelling of ייצר'). Reading A: each prints as the record's note or pointer, not as a pill. Reading B: each prints as a pill like any piece. The declaration marks the role and leaves the printing to the owner.

4. Labels over the line. 114 routes open with a context label and 20 close with one after the final period; held whole (declared). Reading B: divide them like any line; the label stays on the one piece it was written on and the other pieces print without it. v3 divides 104 of them.

5. The store's own cut. In 92 rows (M69 26, M50 66) the route is the definition with its lead label removed ('(anatomy) vagina' printed 'vagina'); in 114 other rows (M25 85, M13 19, M50 6, M11 3, M69 1) the lead label stays on the route. Reading A: the store's cut stands (the label is a topic tag, not part of the reading). Reading B: it is a derivation and the route should be the whole definition, as it is in the other rows.

6. Strong's text inside Wiktionary. 74 routes carry a copied Strong's ':-' KJV list (238 commas, held whole here). Reading A: hold it whole (declared). Reading B: divide it under the Strong's declaration (wikisource_strongs_explicit_forms), whose list it is.

7. Unbalanced groups. 32 routes carry a '(' that never closes (truncated notes). Today's card prints nothing for their damaged sense; this declaration ships each route whole. Reading A: ship whole (declared). Reading B: keep today's drop.
kaikki_wiktionary_hebrew.not_done_here: The definition is never mined for a reading: the route is read where the store cut it. No explanation is substituted for its head, no label is carried forward onto the pieces after it, no group is distributed, no romanization or label is stripped, no pointer is resolved to the form it names. The 92 routes the store already cut after a lead label are read as cut; whether that cut stands is the owner's (open question 5).
